title: The player: a newly embraced vampire with Celerity 1, Potence 1 and the Blood commands at 1
note: SANDBOX (ours, calibrated on the rules package): sandbox.newly_embraced's numbers (the combat rules' Strength 15, Dexterity 23, Stamina 20; the other six Attributes the rules package's Option B means, rounded (research-only): Charisma 17, Manipulation 17, Appearance 22, Perception 17, Intelligence 17, Wits 14; every Ability 0 but Alertness 1) and, ours, Celerity 1 with its option celerity.active and Potence 1 with potence.passive (Christof is Brujah; 1.1's brujahNeo.nai lists Celerity 1), and a Blood pool of 100 (1.1's Christof.NPC line 29, rules/blood). Blood Strength, Blood Dexterity, Blood Stamina and Blood Healing at 1, each with its option (the rules package names common.blood_strength, ...; 1.1's DGRP_Common, which anybody may learn), so the quick slots 1 to 5 hold Celerity, Blood Strength, Blood Dexterity, Blood Stamina and Blood Healing (rules/powers' order). The player's default (a role and no characters). Health from rules/harm (the engine-sandbox Health). A research fixture, not a rule; sandbox.newly_embraced stays power-free (the arena's research fixture).
